questions.question: If f(x) = [a|x|+x²-2(sin|x|)(cos|x|)]/x for x≠0, and f(x)=b for x=0, is continuous at x=0, then a+b is equal to:
questions.solution: Using left/right limits with expansion: -a+2 = a-2 = b gives 2a=4, so a=2, b=0, and a+b=2.

questions.question: Let π/2<θ<π and cotθ = -1/(2√2). Then the value of sin(15θ/2)(cos8θ+sin8θ) + cos(15θ/2)(cos8θ-sin8θ) is equal to:
questions.solution: Expression simplifies to cos(θ/2)-sin(θ/2) = -√(1-sinθ). Using cotθ=-1/(2√2), sinθ=2√2/3, giving -√((3-2√2)/3) = (1-√2)/√3.

questions.question: Let a = î-2ĵ+3k̂, b = 2î+ĵ-k̂, c = λî+ĵ+k̂ and v = a×b. If v·c=11 and the length of the projection of b on c is p, then 9p² is equal to:
questions.solution: Solving determinant equation gives λ=1. Projection of b on c = b·ĉ = 2/√3 = p. So 9p² = 9(4/3) = 12.

questions.question: Let A(1,2) and C(-3,-6) be two diagonally opposite vertices of a rhombus, whose sides AD and BC are parallel to the line 7x-y=14. If B(α,β) and D(γ,δ) are the other two vertices, then |α+β+γ+δ| is equal to:
questions.solution: Midpoint of A and C is (-1,-2), so (α+γ)/2=-1 and (β+δ)/2=-2, giving |α+β+γ+δ|=|-2-4|=6.

questions.question: Consider two sets A = {x∈Z : ||x-3|-3|≤1} and B = {x∈R-{1,2} : [(x-2)(x-4)/(x-1)]log_e(|x-2|)=0}. Then the number of onto functions f:A→B is equal to:
questions.solution: A={-1,0,1,5,6,7} (6 elements), B={3,4} (2 elements). Number of onto functions from a 6-element set to a 2-element set = 2⁶-2 = 62.

questions.question: The system of linear equations x+y+z=6; 2x+5y+az=36; x+2y+3z=b has:
options: unique solution for a=8 and b=16
infinitely many solutions for a=8 and b=14
infinitely many solutions for a=8 and b=16
unique solution for a=8 and b=14
questions.answer: infinitely many solutions for a=8 and b=14
questions.solution: D=0 when a=8. For a=8, D1, D2, D3 are all zero only when b=14, giving infinitely many solutions.

questions.question: The sum of all the real solutions of the equation log_(x+3)(6x²+28x+30) = 5 - 2log_(6x+10)(x²+6x+9) is equal to:
questions.solution: Substituting A=log_(x+3)(6x+10) gives A+4/A=4 or A=2, solving to x²=1, x=±1. Sum of roots = 0.

questions.question: If the points of intersection of the ellipses x²+2y²-6x-12y+23=0 and 4x²+2y²-20x-12y+35=0 lie on a circle of radius r and centre (a,b), then the value of ab+18r² is
questions.solution: Using family of curves S1+λS2=0 with λ=1/2 gives the circle x²+y²-16x/3-6y+27/2=0, centre (8/3,3), radius r=√(47/18). ab+18r²=8+47=55.

questions.question: Let PQ be a chord of the hyperbola x²/4 - y²/b² = 1, perpendicular to the x-axis such that OPQ is an equilateral triangle, O being the centre of the hyperbola. If the eccentricity of the hyperbola is √3, then the area of the triangle OPQ is:
questions.solution: e=√3 gives b²=8, hyperbola x²/4-y²/8=1. Solving with 30° angle condition gives sinθ=1/√6, and area = 4√2·sinθ/cos²θ = 8√3/5.

questions.question: Let a, b, c be three vectors such that a×b = 2(a×c). If |a|=1, |b|=4, |c|=2, and the angle between b and c is 60°, then |a·c| is:
questions.solution: b-2c=λa with λ²=16 gives λ=±4. Dotting b-2c=±4a with c gives |a·c|=1.

questions.question: Bag A contains 9 white and 8 black balls, while bag B contains 6 white and 4 black balls. One ball is randomly picked from bag B and mixed with bag A. Then a ball is randomly drawn from bag A. If the probability that the ball drawn is white is p/q, gcd(p,q)=1, then p+q is equal to:
The area of the region enclosed between the circles x²+y²=4 and x²+(y-2)²=4 is:
questions.solution: Integrating the intersection area: A = 4∫₀^√3(√(4-x²)-1)dx = 8π/3 - 2√3 sq. units, which equals (2/3)(4π-3√3).

questions.question: The least value of (cos²θ - 6sinθcosθ + 3sin²θ + 2) is
questions.solution: Simplifying gives f(θ) = 4 - 3sin2θ - cos2θ, which ranges in [4-√10, 4+√10]. Least value is 4-√10.

questions.question: Let I(x) = ∫3dx/[(4x+6)√(4x²+8x+3)] and I(0) = √3/4 + 20. If I(1/2) = a√2/b + c, where a,b,c∈N, gcd(a,b)=1, then a+b+c is equal to:
questions.solution: Substitution 4x+6=1/t leads to I(x) = (3/4)√[(4x+2)/(4x+6)] + c, with c=20. Evaluating at x=1/2 gives I(1/2) = 3√2/8 + 20, so a=3,b=8,c=20, sum=31.

questions.question: The number of ways, in which 16 oranges can be distributed to four children such that each child gets at least one orange, is
questions.solution: Using stars and bars with each ≥1: reduces to x1'+x2'+x3'+x4'=12, giving C(15,3)=455 solutions.

questions.question: Let A={0,1,2,...,9}. Let R be a relation on A defined by (x,y)∈R iff |x-y| is a multiple of 3. Statement I: n(R)=36. Statement II: R is an equivalence relation.
options: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
questions.answer: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
questions.solution: n(R) = 4×4+3×3+3×3 = 34 (not 36), so Statement I is false. R is reflexive, symmetric, transitive, so it is an equivalence relation — Statement II is true.

questions.question: If z = √3/2 + i/2, i=√-1, then (z²⁰¹-i)⁸ is equal to
questions.solution: z=cos(π/6)+isin(π/6). z²⁰¹ = cos(201π/6)+isin(201π/6) = -i. (z²⁰¹-i)⁸ = (-2i)⁸ = 256.

questions.question: If the mean and the variance of the data (Classes 4-8,8-12,12-16,16-20 with frequencies 3,λ,4,7) are μ and 19 respectively, then the value of λ+μ is
questions.solution: μ = 10+60/(λ+14), requiring λ+14 to divide 60 evenly. Using variance condition gives 19λ²-28λ-516=0, so λ=6, μ=13, λ+μ=19.

questions.question: An equilateral triangle OAB is inscribed in the parabola y²=4x with vertex O at the vertex of the parabola. Then the minimum distance of the circle having AB as a diameter from the origin is
questions.solution: Using slope=tan30° gives t=2√3. Circle centre at (12,0), radius 4√3. Least distance = 12-4√3 = 4(3-√3).

questions.question: Let Σ_{k=1}^n a_k = αn²+βn. If a10=59 and a6=7a1, then α+β is equal to
questions.solution: a10 gives 19α+β=59; a6=7a1 gives 11α+β=7(α+β), leading to 2α=3β. Solving: α=3, β=2, α+β=5.

questions.question: If the solution curve y=f(x) of the differential equation (x²-4)y' - 2xy + 2x(4-x²)² = 0, x>2, passes through the point (3,15), then the local maximum value of f is
questions.solution: d(y/(x²-4)) = -2x dx integrates to y=(-x²+C)(x²-4). With (3,15): C=12. y'=0 at x=2√2, giving local maximum y = ((2√2)²-4)(-(2√2)²+12) = 16.

questions.question: If the image of the point P(a,2,a) in the line x/2=(y+a)/1=z/1 is Q and the image of Q in the line (x-2b)/2=(y-a)/1=(z+2b)/-5 is P, then a+b is equal to.
questions.solution: Setting up the reflection equations for both lines and solving simultaneously gives b=2a and a=1, so b=2, a+b=3.

questions.question: The number of elements in the set S={x : x∈[0,100] and ∫₀ˣ t²sin(x-t)dt = x²} is.....
questions.solution: Integration by parts reduces the integral equation to x²-2(1-cosx)=x², giving cosx=1, so x=0,2π,4π,...,30π — 16 total elements.

questions.question: Let A = [[0,2,-3],[-2,0,1],[3,-1,0]] and B be a matrix such that B(I-A) = I+A. Then the sum of the diagonal elements of B^T B is equal to
questions.solution: Since A^T=-A, computing B^T B = (I+A)^{-1}(I+A)(I-A)(I-A)^{-1} = I. Trace of B^T B = trace(I) = 3 (3x3 identity).

questions.question: Let S denote the set of 4-digit numbers abcd such that a>b>c>d and P denote the set of 5-digit numbers having product of its digits equal to 20. Then n(S)+n(P) is equal to.
questions.solution: n(S)=C(10,4)=210 (choosing 4 distinct digits and arranging in decreasing order). For n(P): digit combinations (5,4,1,1,1) and (5,2,2,1,1) give 5!/3!+5!/(2!2!) = 20+30 = 50. Total = 210+50 = 260.
